source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Structural abnormalities within the brain's physical anatomy, rather than its ongoing electrical activity","B":"A test generally considered to lack any clearly established clinical use in the evaluation of suspected seizure activity","C":"Blood flow to the brain, rather than the electrical activity this particular test is actually designed to measure","D":"Electrical activity of the brain, helping identify abnormal patterns associated with seizure activity"}}
source_row.rationale: An EEG measures the electrical activity of the brain, helping identify abnormal patterns associated with seizure activity, a key diagnostic tool for evaluating suspected seizure disorders, distinct from structural imaging tests like CT or MRI.
source_row.source_name: AAN — EEG Use in Seizure Evaluation
